name: TransformerLoadingMonitor
tagline: See which distribution transformers are overloaded or will be – and fund the right upgrades first.
description: A complete transformer loading and upgrade planning app for electric utilities: peak loading against watch / overload / critical thresholds, IEEE C57.91-style hot-spot and aging estimate, a load forecast with growth and pending EV chargers, reverse power flow risk from solar, standard-size recommendations with cost, and upgrade cases from flag through engineering review, approval limits, scheduling with outage notice and completion to verification – in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with a fictional 48-transformer, 6-feeder network
Hot-spot and aging factor estimate (IEEE C57.91 style)
Growth and pending-EV forecast with overload year
Reverse power flow risk from solar
Drag-and-drop upgrade board with guarded transitions
Engineer approval limit and critical-unit rules
Work order scheduling with outage notice
Completion writes the new rating back
Capital plan by year with unplanned need
Upgrade request, capital plan, CSV and summary outputs
Undo, read-only, disabled, empty and map-your-columns states
